about_the_game:
A Sudden Incident in the Peaceful Nyacle Village!

Totto and Chiro return from their part-time job collecting medicinal herbs, only to find that the residents of Nyakuru Village have turned to stone!

To restore them, they need the power of "Soup" made in the Magic Pot.

Join Totto on an adventurous journey to gather soup recipes!

The World of Adventure

The Alnial Region is filled with unique and diverse locations:

  • A stump village where cats live

  • A farming village inhabited by dogs

  • A subterranean village home to lizards

  • And even a forest covered in cake...!?

Collecting Recipes

Soup recipes can be obtained by helping villagers with their requests or by defeating bosses.

When visiting a new place for the first time, be sure to check the bookshelves in the houses—you never know what you might find!

Cooking Soup

Once you've found a recipe, gather the ingredients and brew the magical soup.

By giving the stone-turned villagers their favorite soup, you can break the petrification curse.

Use the notes from Chiro to deduce which soup each cat loves the most!

Battles

Combat follows a classic turn-based system, but some enemies may be resistant to regular attacks or unleash powerful moves!

Pay close attention to boss dialogues—they may contain hints on how to defeat them.

Plenty of Collectibles

① Finding Poripori

Forty Poripori have escaped from Parco and are hiding all over the map.

If you listen carefully in the field, you might hear the sound of a hidden Poripori...!

② Ancient Relics

Once you obtain a shovel, you can dig at marked spots.

If you uncover an ancient relic, take it to Tonbo the archaeologist for analysis!

③ Stamp Book

During your journey, you'll receive a Stamp Book that lets you play mini-games at stamp stations across the land.

Carefully observe the sample designs and create pixel art stamps!

④ Commemorative Stamps

In the post office somewhere in Arnyarl, you can receive commemorative stamps based on your achievements.

There are 12 types in total—try to collect them all!
